title: IterateSpec
description: Autonomous iterate-until-target spec. Holds ONE model family fixed and searches its hyperparameters and (optionally) its feature selection to reach the objective's kpi.target, stopping as soon as the target is met OR a trial/time/cost budget is exhausted. The objective still owns labels/KPI/target — this spec only defines what the loop is allowed to vary and how long it may run.

objective_id.description: Optional cross-check; if present must equal the objective the loop runs against.

candidate.description: The pinned model. Its `family` is fixed for the whole loop; `params`/`features` are the starting point that the search perturbs.

id.description: Candidate id for leaderboard/filenames. Defaults to `family`.

family.description: Registered plugin/catalog family (fixed across all iterations).

params.description: Baseline hyperparameters; sampled search-space values are merged over these.

max_rows.description: Row cap per iteration (null/omit = all rows).

search_space.description: Optuna-style hyperparameter space (same format as CatalogEntry.search_space). Omit to use the family's catalog search_space. Required if the family has no catalog search_space.

feature_choices.description: Feature selections the loop may pick among (categorical). Omit to keep the candidate's `features` fixed while only hyperparameters vary.

budget.description: Stopping budget. The loop always stops early when kpi.target is met; otherwise it stops at whichever budget limit is hit first. If none given, defaults to max_trials=30.

max_trials.description: Max iterations (default 30 when no budget key is set).

cost_budget_usd.description: Estimated GPU-time budget in USD (rough per-family estimate).

feature_selection.description: Explicit feature pick. Exactly ONE of view / prefixes / columns.
